name: pi-claude-code
description: pi extensions: Claude Code CLI as model provider (one or more accounts), Antigravity CLI (agy) as model provider, a status line for CLI providers with mode (Shift+Tab), model, context and plan usage, a chart of the plan usage of every account and the tokens of every model over time (/usage), the CLI agent's task list above the editor, the CLI agent's running subagents above the editor with a popup showing each one's output live (/subagents), pi's own MCP server for the CLIs (permission prompts answered in pi, questions to the user in a dialog, wishes to change pi and a wish list shown in the empty chat and in a popup (/wishes), pi's state and settings to read and change, watches that wait for CI runs and the like and start a new turn with the result (/watches)), a retry dialog for denied actions, a provider logo for empty chats, a chat crab acting out the agent, chat view changes (sticky prompt, steer and queue panel with steer now, grouped thinking and tools, readable tool calls with highlighted code, tables, line numbers and images collapsed until Ctrl+O, code blocks, Mermaid diagrams too wide turned or sent back to the model, extension list, prompt history, framed command list, answer box for long rounds, smooth editor height), image paste (image files named in a prompt, e.g. pasted with Ctrl+V, attached to the message), work status (working animation, duration line, tab title, notifications, session titles from the smallest model) and common commands (/clear, /effort, /export)
